description: cluster 级质量审查 · v28 程序驱动（2026-06-22 G2 P0a 实装）：机械层 audit_hub（13+ scanner advisory）+ 跨章 validate_chapter（hard_gate）+ LLM 双 judge（reading-reflector audit / voice-checker · 真 API · elysia gen-model）→ 综合 quality_report.json

steps.name: cluster-mechanical-audit
steps.description: audit_hub.py --mode cluster · 跑 13+ cluster 视野 scanner（validate_chapter/validate_style/narrative/plot_structure/hook/golden_three/semantic_slop/voice_drift/foreshadowing_handoff/locked_fact/pov/prose_rhythm/...）· 不 --auto-fix（只报告·检查模式）· 全部 advisory 汇总到 cluster_{key}_audit.json

steps.name: cluster-cross-chapter-validate
steps.description: validate_chapter.validate_cluster() · 整 cluster 章范围 hard_gate 校验（CLUSTER_MODE=1·CLUSTER_PER_CHAPTER=1·逐章跑后聚合 fatal/error/warning）· 抓 LOCKED_FACT_CONFLICT / FUTURE_KNOWLEDGE_LEAK / FORESHADOWING_NOT_PAID / MANIFEST_MISSING 等 hard_gate 码 · 落盘 cluster_{key}_validate.json

steps.name: judge-llm+quality-report
steps.description: judge_runner 双 judge 真 API（elysia gen-model）：novel-reading-reflector ROUND=1（阅读体验审查 · advisory · 作者档第一权威）+ novel-voice-checker（cluster 整声纹 · 角色 voice_pack 校验）· 综合 step1 audit + step2 validate + 双 judge 输出 → cluster_{key}_quality_report.json（verdict/scores/advisory_count/hard_gate_count/sample_issues）
